name: 98418 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98418 (Tacoma) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98418 (Tacoma) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98418 (Tacoma) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
